thread:
Diego (Marketing): Need a compact benchmark asset pack for next week's milestone. Goals: clear comparison storytelling (latency vs unit cost), accessible color variants, and a webinar hero with a small "Dedicated vs Hosted" callout. Deadline: next Tue EOD.

Ben (Creative Ops): List exact outputs and file formats please.

Diego (Marketing): Deliverables: benchmark tile (SVG + PNGs + Figma components), social hero set (LinkedIn/Twitter/IG sizes + mobile banner), webinar slide (1920x1080 + 16:9 export), one-page PDF diagram with sparkline and footnote, accessibility contrast screenshots. CTA primary: "Try Redwood Inference". Alt CTA for AB: "Ship with Redwood".

Ava (Design): Qs: brand color tokens? dark-mode needed? localization targets?

Priya (Product Marketing): Use core brand palette + add high-contrast mono for accessibility. Localize EN + DE + FR (but only EN for social initial drop). Copy options (short):
A) "Lower latency. Fewer dollars. Predictable inference."
B) "Run LLMs reliably at scale and at cost."
C) "Serve smarter: faster responses, lower unit cost."
Use A by default.

Eli (Legal): Avoid numeric claims without source. If we include any % or x factor, attach benchmark data and test plan; otherwise include a footnote: "Based on internal tests; results vary by model and config."

Ava (Design): I'll create a Figma file with components and three visual variants (light, dark, high-contrast). Breakpoints I'll follow: `1920x1080`, `1200x675`, `640x360`. Will include alt-text suggestions and export slices.

figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-wins-kit components: /bench-tiles, /social-heroes, /webinar-slide

Ben (Creative Ops): Timeline: Ava 3 business days for first pass, me 1 day for QA/exports. Deliver checklist: SVG master, PNG@1x/2x per size, PDF one-pager with visible footnote layer, Figma handoff link, contrast screenshots.

Diego (Marketing): Also include a small two-column callout on the webinar slide for "Dedicated vs Hosted" benefits (icons for routing/latency/cost). If legal needs footnote placement changed, we'll adjust before final export.

Priya (Product Marketing): I'll drop final EN copy into Figma and prepare the webinar speaking notes to align with visuals.

Eli (Legal): I'll sign off on the non-numeric copy and review the exported PDF footnote before distribution.

Ben (Creative Ops): Kicking off. Ping here for scope creep (animations, extra languages) so we can reprioritize. :rocket:
